name: facebook-private-cleaner
description: PoC Chrome/Edge extension that scans the Facebook Activity Log and classifies post audiences; V1A/V1B act on one Only-me post, V2A/V2B move a hand-picked batch of up to 20 Only-me posts to Trash; V3A loads older Activity Log entries by scrolling (read-only); V3B plans a cleanup queue of max-20 batches run one at a time with explicit approval; V4 runs the remaining queue batches sequentially after one approval, stopping at the first anomaly; V5 chains them into a guided cleanup (load, scan, plan, one final approval, run).

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
